analyst.text: A straight shoot-out for West Group B: Minnesota win the group with a win, and Memphis can be eliminated with a loss. The Wolves are without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo, and LaMelo Ball is questionable after being carried off with an ankle sprain against Oklahoma City on Wednesday. Memphis have won seven of eight but lost rookie Cameron Boozer (ankle, about four weeks) and Jerami Grant (calf). Motivation is even; if Ball sits, the news leans Memphis.
